_comment: Defaults, so the flags do not have to be typed every time. Copy to
and edit. Anything left out is worked out automatically -- run
`python3 sfbp.py paths` to see what that finds on your machine.
Command-line flags override this file; this file overrides autodetection.
The values below are a real Linux/Proton setup, kept as a worked example.
on macOS it is inside the CrossOver or Whisky bottle.
